final_message:
`diffLines`, `renderDiff` and `diffStats` are implemented in `src/diff.ts`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

- **`diffLines`** builds a suffix LCS table, then walks both arrays front to back. It keeps equal lines, and otherwise deletes `a[i]` only if the remaining LCS doesn't drop, inserting `b[j]` otherwise. This is the README's tie-break rule.
- **`renderDiff`** and **`diffStats`** follow the README directly.

I also checked the implementation against a separate reference on random inputs. It round-trips both arrays, returns a true LCS, leaves the inputs unmodified, and matches the README's tie-break exactly. The scratch scripts were in `/tmp` and are removed; the only repo change is `src/diff.ts`, not committed.

The table is O(n·m) in memory, so very large inputs will use a lot of memory.
